newsArticles.title: WTC Nepal Expands Diagnostics Reach to Province 1 and Madhesh Province
newsArticles.excerpt: WTC Nepal strengthens its diagnostics distribution network with new partnerships and service touchpoints in Province 1 and Madhesh Province, bringing advanced IVD solutions closer to regional laboratories.
newsArticles.content:
WTC Nepal is expanding its Diagnostics division service network into Province 1 and Madhesh Province. This strategic expansion gives hospitals, diagnostic centres, and clinical laboratories in these regions closer access to WTC Nepal's range of In-Vitro Diagnostics equipment, reagents, application support, and service assistance.

The expansion includes additional regional representatives and pre-sales application specialists who can support on-site demonstrations, installation coordination, user training, and routine maintenance planning. This aligns with WTC Nepal's mission to make world-class diagnostic solutions accessible throughout Nepal.

The company currently serves hospitals, diagnostic centres, clinics, and healthcare institutions nationwide and continues to grow its footprint in collaboration with multinational partner companies.

newsArticles.title: WTC Nepal Introduces Next-Generation Infection Control Solutions for Nepali Hospitals
newsArticles.excerpt: The Disinfection division of WTC Nepal launches an expanded portfolio of sterilization and disinfection products designed to meet evolving infection prevention standards in Nepali healthcare facilities.
newsArticles.content:
WTC Nepal's Disinfection division has introduced an expanded portfolio of infection prevention and control products in response to growing demand for reliable sterilization solutions in Nepal's healthcare sector. The range includes steam sterilization, low-temperature sterilization, endoscope reprocessing, surface hygiene, and healthcare waste treatment solutions from global partner companies.

With healthcare infrastructure continuing to modernize across Nepal, hospitals and clinics need validated systems, dependable consumables, and service support that keeps infection control programs running consistently.

WTC Nepal's biomedical engineering team provides installation coordination, operator training, preventive maintenance, and validation support so facilities can keep essential disinfection workflows stable from day one.
newsArticles.author: WTC Nepal Editorial Team

newsArticles.title: WTC Nepal Launches Advanced Aesthetic Dermatology Portfolio Under Care Division
newsArticles.excerpt: WTC Nepal's Care division expands into aesthetic dermatology with clinically focused laser systems and non-invasive platforms for specialist clinics and hospitals.
newsArticles.content:
WTC Nepal has expanded its Care division with an advanced aesthetic dermatology portfolio for private clinics, dermatology practices, and hospital departments across Nepal. The portfolio supports laser-based procedures, skin rejuvenation, body contouring, and critical care equipment needs.

Nepal's dermatology and aesthetic care market continues to grow as practitioners seek clinically validated technology, practical training, and responsive after-sales service. WTC Nepal's Care division is positioned to support this demand through global partner relationships and specialist application support.

Devices in the portfolio are supported by user training, demonstration sessions, maintenance planning, and access to WTC Nepal's service network.
